BTG_BionicThumb.description.english:
A full bionic hand, branded and sold by the Bionic Thumb Guild as simply "the bionic thumb." The polyarthric thumb dominates the prosthetic's design — extra articulation points, micro-servo clusters, and a dedicated neural feedback loop all serve the thumb first. The other fingers get whatever engineering budget was left over, which to be fair is still pretty impressive.

Popular among coin collectors, card sharks, and anyone who respects good branding.

BTG_InstallBionicThumb.description.english: Install a bionic thumb. It's a whole hand, but the Guild insists you call it a thumb.

BTG_BionicThumb.description.english:
The flagship product of the Bionic Thumb Guild: a full bionic hand prosthetic built entirely around the perfect thumb. Every servo, joint, and actuator in the other four fingers exists to support the thumb's extraordinary polyarthric range of motion. The Guild's engineers insist the name is accurate — the thumb is the hand, the rest is just scaffolding.

Flip coins with superhuman precision. The other fingers are just along for the ride.
